remarks:
Escape to your own private country retreat! This picturesque 4-acre property offers the perfect blend of open and wooded land, highlighted by a large scenic pond that creates a peaceful setting for relaxation or recreation. The insulated, drywalled one-room cabin features wood laminate flooring and a cathedral ceiling creating a warm, rustic atmosphere. Off the front of the cabin is a covered porch where you can enjoy views of the property, the pond, and the wildlife. The cabin has a security system. Offered fully furnished, this turnkey getaway is ready to enjoy from day one.

The property also includes a gravel driveway, storage shed, and electric service. A well and septic system are present but have not been connected or used since 2007; their condition is unknown and they are being conveyed as-is.

Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the exceptional location, just 1.2 miles from Brokenstraw State Forest and 3.7 miles from Panama State Forest, providing convenient access to hiking, hunting, fishing, wildlife, and countless other outdoor activities.

Whether you're looking for a peaceful weekend escape, a hunting camp, or the perfect location to build your future home, this unique property offers endless possibilities in a beautiful country setting.
